description.value: The Shipyard Restaurant & Pub occupies an authentic converted boat-building facility right on the waterfront at Maple Bay Marina, with views of Bird's Eye Cove and regular activity from boats and float planes. The menu centers on fresh seafood — particularly the house clam chowder and fish and chips — drawing loyal regulars who drive from Victoria specifically for the food. A seasonal patio and casual marina-side pub atmosphere make it a memorable stop on a coastal cycling route.
